officialErrata.priority: Errata supersedes printed text; Corellian Slip free-attack action and Squadron Tactics exception are mandatory.

mechanicalPrinciples.rollType: Most maneuvers roll Pilot; five [gunner] maneuvers use vehicle weapon attack rolls vs target Reflex, and [Force] Target Sense rolls Use the Force.
mechanicalPrinciples.tierSelection: For fixed DC take highest qualifying DC tier; for gunner attack margin take highest matching non-overlapping Reflex margin tier. Snap Roll directly replaces Reflex and has no DC.
successPriority: execute movement or existing attack as specified
fixed DC or attack margin/defense comparison
apply choice of tier including failure side effects
apply vehicle damage/mitigation and effect clocks once
powerRecovery: Maneuver suite has independent spent state and duplicate instances
1 minute rest after starship battle restores all
natural 20 specifically on Pilot activation restores all at end of TURN
spend 1 FP as reaction restores one
Tactical Genius talent expands recovery to natural 20 attack rolls at end of ROUND
mechanicalPrinciples.modifierApplication: Apply explicit feat/talent/Force modifier relationships; Force Pilot changes Pilot modifier source only, Force Reflexes rerolls Pilot, Target Sense UTF substitutes vehicle-weapon attack modifier. No generic tag/name heuristic.
mechanicalPrinciples.errataPriority: January 2008 WotC Starships errata overrides printed; fighter groups and squadron maneuvers obey errata.

unresolvedSourceInterpretations.issue: Confirm the V2 vehicle damage pipeline already decrements SR 5 when damage beats current SR, and apply that standard decrement once before maneuver-specific SR loss.
Normal collision resolution when the target survives uses shared V2 vehicle collision authority; the maneuver defines avoidance on failure but not a bespoke collision damage formula.

Removing 1 vehicle weapon damage die when a weapon has only one damage die has no explicit floor in the printed maneuver. Shared V2 vehicle damage grammar must establish the legal lower bound; otherwise escalate.

Gunner tables say attack exceeds Reflex by 0-4; use the general hit comparison (hit on meeting or beating defense) while applying margin 0 at exact equality. Verify shared combat authority matches this rule.
Printed rule gives no numeric upper bound on voluntarily chosen attack penalty N. Do not invent an undocumented cap; user-choice legality must respect the canonical attack modifier rules.
Printed Source says Charisma bonus rather than Charisma modifier. Use nonnegative bonus as the substitution; confirm shared V2 ability stat semantics, and avoid adding Cha bonus atop ship Int.
